python.note: Saved-data analysis requires Python 3.10 or later; build/export helpers were checked with Python 3.13 and psutil 7.2.2.

java.cost_probe_build: build.py --with-probes emits cost-probe as well as gen8-probe; pure source transformations match the archived builders

requirements: provided generated AndroidX Gradle project with cases.csv
access to pinned Maven dependencies or a supplied cache
benchmark_build.user_homes: build_fragbench sets JVM user.home and ANDROID_USER_HOME below --output; SDK packages must be preinstalled, plugin SDK mutations are outside its write-location guarantee

scope: Portable builders, a functional single-APK exporter, and a new single-APK serial five-configuration/five-repetition measured launcher. New measurements do not assert equivalence to the historical controlled-background500-run environment.
